description: Pinned external dependencies for the LabVIEW authoring + lvkit static self-test track (LBA-REQ-016/017/018; proposal docs/proposals/labview-authoring-and-lvkit-selftest.md). Three pinned sections: gitRepos (by commit SHA), pipTools (by pip version + Python bitness), vipmPackages (by a committed .vipc). Windows-first; the Windows LabVIEW VM is LabVIEW 2026 32-bit. Everything is pinned + the verifier fails closed on drift; the authoring stack is VM-sandboxed and all dependency tool text is treated as untrusted (see the proposal security section).

gitRepos.name: labview_assistant
gitRepos.notes: MCP server that scripts the LabVIEW IDE via win32com ActiveX + a DQMH module. Runs under 32-bit Python (pywin32 32-bit binds the 32-bit LabVIEW 2026 ActiveX server); requires DQMH (see vipmPackages). VM-sandboxed only; its create+RUN of arbitrary VIs is code-exec and its tool docs are untrusted input.

gitRepos.name: labview-icon-editor
gitRepos.notes: 32-bit VI corpus authored-against / analyzed. Already mirrored for the VI Analyzer .viancfg pattern (experiments/vi-analyzer/icon-editor-report.json).

pipTools.name: lvkit
pipTools.notes: Static VI reader/differ (read-only; never executes a VI; no LabVIEW). Cross-plane SECOND OPINION only (vi-history-suite stays authoritative). MUST run on 64-bit Python: its cryptography dependency has no win32 wheel, so a 32-bit build fails. Proven on the LINUX plane: Python 3.12.8 x64 + lvkit 0.5.7 -> deterministic `lvkit describe --verbose`, rc=0.

pipTools.name: pylabview
pipTools.notes: lvkit's transitive VI-binary parser; its EXACT version is the cross-plane determinism linchpin (lvkit netlist/JSON must be byte-identical WIN vs LINUX before any fixture is committed). LINUX-verified: lvkit 0.5.7 resolves pylabview==0.1.2 on the VM (64-bit Python 3.12.8). LINUX will re-confirm the SAME resolves on the LINUX host before committing any cross-plane lvkit fixture; if the two planes disagree, pin lvkit's whole transitive set (not just pylabview).

vipmPackages.name: dqmh
vipmPackages.notes: DQMH (Delacor Queued Message Handler) + ALL transitive deps (JKI State Machine at minimum), pinned via a committed .vipc that resolves + pins transitively, applied on the GUEST by `vipm install <vipc> --labview-version 2026 --labview-bitness 32 -y`. VIPM EDITION SPLIT (LINUX-verified on the decouple VM): the GUEST runs VIPM 2026.3.0 COMMUNITY, which refuses to run outside a public git repo (so vipm is invoked with CWD inside a public-repo checkout) and is TEXT-ONLY (no --json); the WIN HOST runs VIPM Pro (no restriction, --json available). The VIPM CLI is NOT Pro-gated for the .vipc apply. LINUX authors + verifies the resolved .vipc set on the VM. The authoritative cross-plane gate artifact stays the deterministic lvkit netlist; vipm is used only for the DQMH-installed env check (`list --installed` + rc).
